title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Improper Verification… (CVE-2026-91899)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 contain a vulnerability involving improper verification of cryptographic signatures. This flaw could allow a high privileged local attacker to elevate privileges and execute arbitrary code on the affected system. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.4, indicating a medium severity level.
